spec_family.name: New Construction Drywall Wall Prime
spec_family.description: PVA or drywall primer on bare drywall wall surfaces in new construction. Single primer coat to seal drywall and provide uniform porosity for finish coats. Includes QT-driven substrate inspection/repair as prep phase. Spray-only is NEVER valid — backroll is mandatory for primer on bare drywall.

configuration_dimensions.description: Drives inspection/repair intensity. Application quality is constant at all tiers.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT5 not applicable to primer-only scope.

configuration_dimensions.description: Method for applying primer to walls.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray-only is NEVER valid for priming bare drywall. Backroll is mandatory.

configuration_dimensions.description: Wall height category affecting production rates.
Drywall finish level affecting primer coverage rate.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Level 3 = more absorption. Level 5 = may require high-build primer.

configuration_dimensions.description: Wall texture affecting coverage rate and roller nap selection.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Modifiers: smooth=1.0, orange_peel=1.10, knockdown=1.15. Use 1/2" nap for textured, NOT 3/4".

research_corrections.corrected_to: NC drywall fasteners do NOT require spot-priming — fasteners are mudded by drywall contractor and modern screws are rust-resistant
research_corrections.rationale: Field contractor expertise: fasteners are covered with joint compound, no exposed metal

research_corrections.corrected_to: PVA and acrylic latex drywall primers are SEALERS only — zero stain blocking capability
research_corrections.rationale: Field contractor expertise: these products seal porous drywall but do not block stains

research_corrections.corrected_to: Floor protection is conditional on floor_type site condition — subfloor may require no protection
research_corrections.rationale: Field contractor expertise: NC sequence often has subfloor only, no protection needed

research_corrections.original_claim: Dry times can be specified in specs
research_corrections.corrected_to: Do not specify dry times in specs — too many variables, refer to PDS
research_corrections.rationale: Field contractor expertise: ambient conditions, ventilation, film thickness all affect dry time

critical_constraints.spray_only_prohibited: Spray-only is NEVER a valid application method for primer on bare drywall. Backroll is MANDATORY to consolidate primer into drywall pores.
critical_constraints.no_ceiling_masking: Do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls. Cut in (roll method) or spray directly into corner (spray_backroll when ceiling is primed).
critical_constraints.roller_nap_textured: Use 1/2" nap for orange peel and knockdown textures. Do NOT use 3/4" nap — that's only for stomp/popcorn or porous masonry.
critical_constraints.roller_size_flexibility: 18-inch roller is typical for spray+backroll but 9-inch is acceptable when obstacles prevent 18-inch use.

cross_spec_coordination.impact: If inspection/repair is performed during wall prime, SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH should check this flag and reduce or eliminate its first inspection/repair round to avoid double-counting labor.

change_log.changes: Initial draft spec family for NC drywall wall priming.

change_log.author: SpecFactory Pipeline (Claude)
change_log.changes: Complete redo in new format with all review corrections applied. Key changes: (1) Spray-only prohibited — backroll mandatory; (2) No ceiling masking — cut in or spray into corner; (3) 1/2" nap for knockdown (not 3/4"); (4) 18" roller typical but 9" acceptable; (5) Floor protection conditional on floor_type; (6) Wall rates are independent (not derived from ceiling); (7) Cut-in for roll method only; (8) All RC-001 through RC-004 applied.
